people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have trespassed, and have married foreign women, to increase the guilt of Israel.
translations.bsb: Then Ezra the priest stood up and said to them, “You have been unfaithful by marrying foreign women, adding to the guilt of Israel.
translations.kjv: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have transgressed, and have taken strange wives, to increase the trespass of Israel.
translations.asv: And Ezra the priest stood up, and said unto them, Ye have trespassed, and have married foreign women, to increase the guilt of Israel.
